name: ifc-vscode
description: IFC (.ifc) language support with full EXPRESS WHERE validation — entity & type WHERE rules, Global RULE, UNIQUE, and DERIVE checks on ISO 10303-21 STEP files. Syntax highlighting, diagnostics, go-to-definition, and LSP for BIM workflows.

ifc.validation.structure.description: Validate STEP encoding, attribute types, aggregate bounds, and entity keywords.

ifc.validation.types.description: Evaluate Type WHERE rules and DERIVE expressions for * attributes.

ifc.validation.rules.description: Evaluate entity WHERE rules, Global RULE, and UNIQUE constraints.

scripts.build: npm run check-types && node esbuild.js && npm run build-server
scripts.package:win32-x64: node build-server.js win32-x64 && vsce package --target win32-x64 --no-dependencies -o dist/ifc-vscode-win32-x64.vsix
scripts.package:linux-x64: node build-server.js linux-x64 && vsce package --target linux-x64 --no-dependencies -o dist/ifc-vscode-linux-x64.vsix && node fix-vsix-exec.js dist/ifc-vscode-linux-x64.vsix
scripts.package:all: npm run package:win32-x64 && npm run package:linux-x64
